resources.string: Parked! Pin saved — accurate to about %1$d m.
Couldn\'t get your location. Make sure location is turned on and try again.
Parkhere needs your location to show the map around you and to drop the pin where you parked. Your location is only used on this device.
Location permission denied. You can still see the map, but we can\'t find your car without it.
Location permission is off. Open the app settings and allow location access so Parkhere can pin your parking spot.
Parkhere only has approximate location, which can be off by a kilometre or more. Open Settings → Permissions → Location and choose “Precise” so the pin lands on your car.
